summary: Published DEB, RPM, AppImage, and Pacman packages from source commit 76519b2d. The release adds the experimental Ferrite RT-950 Pro link-protocol driver and web profile; renders corrupt Baofeng tone words as no tone; names the refused channel and write progress for live-radio refusals; adds FT-60 clone/cable guidance, sibling-model selection, and AnyTone USB guidance; prefers XWayland on Linux; adds the PMR446 frequency reference; and includes TH-D7G, UV-5R Mini, AT-D878UVII Plus, 5RX, and Wayland follow-up fixes. Verification: flutter analyze passed; all 254 Flutter tests passed with the bundled Python 3.13 runtime; 653 bundled Python tests passed with two fixture-dependent skips; the Ubuntu 20.04 ABI check passed with maximum GLIBC 2.18; DEB, RPM, and Pacman metadata and embedded version 1.0.74 were verified; DEB and AppImage Xvfb smoke tests passed; the AppImage launched under host Wayland and X11; package payloads include Ferrite, Baofeng tone handling, PMR446, and bridge updates and omit GLVND/EGL/GLES loaders; all public downloads returned HTTP 200; and the Linux platform manifest reports 1.0.74.
